verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents serving your own fine-tuned weights on dedicated autoscaling GPU instances with a private endpoint, so the serve half of the story is direct. The fine-tune half is only covered by renting B200/B300 GPU clusters 'for training' with SSH access, which is raw compute rather than a managed way to fine-tune a supported base model on your data. Missing for 10: a managed fine-tuning API or workflow for catalog base models, documentation of a train-to-deploy pipeline on the platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune a supported base model on my own data and serve the result on the same platform
